about: Oakville is a lakeshore town between Toronto and Hamilton, in Halton Region on Lake Ontario. It is an affluent municipality with a preserved downtown, ravines, and a large Ford assembly plant. GO Transit and the QEW tie it to the rest of the Greater Toronto Area. About 210,000 people live in Oakville.
seoSummary: Affluent Halton lakeshore town between Toronto and Hamilton, with a harbour downtown.
knownFor: High median incomes relative to Ontario
